text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...I've packed on some pounds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since becoming a trainer, I've had
more
opportunities to eat out with the
students. As a
result, I've put on weight.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hellooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hello! ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Trainer?! You seem kinda
sad! Are
you feeling sick?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That would be way too tragiiiic!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I see now. Well, you've been
spending a lot
of time with us
Umamusume, and most of us have
big
appetites.
choice_data_list: いや、ちょっと太っちゃって

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooh! How responsible!
choice_data_list: ダイエットしようかな

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As someone whose role it is to guide
trainees, I
want to set an example by
keeping myself in
good physical shape.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Your dedication is so TOUCHIIIING!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing! You're incredible, Trainer!
You have
a will of STEEL!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I've made up my mind! I'm going
to help
you out, and I'm going at it full
blast!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
FULL THROTTLE! I'll back you up to the
max,
Trainer! We can do it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Ticket at full throttle?! This could
be
dangerous. You'd better watch out,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
J-just help out at regular throttle,
Ticket! Let's
hold back a little and put in
an ordinary amount
of effort.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you think that's best? Maybe
you're right...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? Full
throttle?! Or an
ordinary amount of
effort?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm sooo impressed!
choice_data_list: ふ、『普通』でお願いします……

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll throw together a plan
that
smashes all your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! First up, we're going to run
until the sun
sets!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: H-hold on, Ticket! It's only midday!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Trainer! ...Hey, are you
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This run marks the start of my
full-throttle
training. My body's so worn
out that I can't
manage another step.
Totally drained, I only
manage to flop
onto my desk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I'm still alive. I guess Winning Ticket
must
have dialed things back a little for
my sake.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! Trainer, you were running like
your life
depended on it! Just picturing
it brings tears to
my eyeeees!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You really did great out there. Here,
have some
water.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What you eat after a workout is another
super
vital part of dieting!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're going full throttle when it comes
to food,
too, so I've handpicked a
low-calorie menu for
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, I get the sense that I'm being
naive
about how easy this all seems...
choice_data_list: 何から何までありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! Low-cal tofu, natto, grilled
fish,
chicken breast, miso soup packed
with kelp, and
a large serving of fish
cakes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Really? But it's a pretty ordinary amount
for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it probably is ordinary for an
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eat and eat, but don't even make a
dent in the
mass of food piled before
me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I just went full-throttle to fetch you
another
serving, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We have to think about nutritional
balance! I got
you boiled spinach, brown
rice, stir-fried
mushrooms, root veggies,
soy milk, yogurt, and a
large salad!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eat up and get bigger! At full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eat so much that my body gives out,
and I
collapse on the floor.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: TRAAAINEEERRR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm reminded today that an Umamusume
at full
throttle is an incredible thing to
behold.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Great choice. It's best not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to helping you out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now then... We'll start with a light

thirty-kilometer run!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Is there a problem?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Of course! Thirty kilometers is ordinary. Very much so!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WHOOOAAA! I'm sooo impressed!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For Machitan, even a thirty-kilometer
run is
ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's just run like normal and shoot
for
thirty!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Keep it up! You've only run ten
kilometers so far!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! Trainer, you're running like
your life
depends on it! Your
commitment's giving me
infinite
motivatiooon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Come on, you can do it! You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yeah, I don't think this is gonna
cut it...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I wanna see more oomph in your running!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Let's bunny hop the last twenty

kilometers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The brutal training causes my body to
tap out,
leaving me collapsed on the
ground.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm reminded today that what's ordinary
for an
Umamusume is anything but for
me.
